items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: He had cut my hair, sure. He cut my hair right there.

ctx.x: You remember a fellow named Pinky Allen at the old man's saloon?

Yeah, I remember Pinky Allen. He had cut my hair, sure. He cut my hair right there. He had a barbershop right there in Howard Avenue Rampart. And he had this old man's saloon? Yeah, the old man's saloon. And Vic Dubar was right over Pinky Allen's where they danced upstairs.
They danced upstairs and his saloon was downstairs?
